close_reason: Already addressed: blob_exists doc strengthened in yqo.7 (same session). Duplicate finding.
description: backend.rs blob_exists has a default impl that returns false unconditionally. The doc comment warns implementors to override it, but any backend that forgets will cause Email/parse to report every blob as notFound even when it exists, silently failing parse requests. The risk: implementors who follow the trait doc may miss this override because the default compiles and 'works' without any obvious error. A better design would remove the default (requiring all impls to provide it) or return an error type that forces acknowledgment. At minimum, the MemoryBackend sets a good example, but contributors who copy from MemoryBackend may not realize the default is wrong.
title: blob_exists default returns false — Email/parse always reports notFound
